label_source: Directory, manifest, dataset_index.csv, feature CSV and metadata agree; this does not independently verify the physical experiment or labels.
output_order: C1 through C5; within each condition g01 through g15, not reordered using capture times

accel_frequency_band_validation.rule: Match feature_spec §4.6 and App: blank if low >= Nyquist or high > Nyquist. The unpatched repository fallback can return a partial-band value that must not be treated as a full-band feature.

archived_vs_recomputed_diagnostics.comparison: Number of groups with a difference >2e-6 in the original feature units or blank mismatch. Not an input for extraction; source CSV rounds exported XYZ to 4 decimals while the App operated on its original sensor precision.

noise_method.generator: NumPy PCG64, SeedSequence([seed, condition ordinal 1..5, group index])
noise_method.signal: Float64 add zero-mean, unit-RMS Gaussian noise scaled to full WAV RMS and target SNR. Three levels in each group share scaled versions of the same realization; different groups have independent deterministic seeds. No cross-group slicing.
noise_method.headroom: When an additive sum exceeds the normalized PCM16 rails, apply one common linear gain to clean audio and noise, preserving SNR. No sample clipping, quantization, or audio output files.
noise_method.measurement: 20 log10(RMS(gain * clean) / RMS(mixture - gain * clean)); measured on the actual float64 feature-extractor input
noise_method.acceleration: Extracted once from corresponding raw CSV; same 12 formatted accelerometer values at each SNR. Missing features remain blank.
